policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.185: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes
source_quote: up to four initial applications of skin and soft tissue substitutes/cellular and tissue-based products (CTPs) are medically necessary for diabetic foot ulcers (DFU) or venous leg ulcers (VLU) when all the following criteria are met, specific to the wound for which the skin substitute/CTP is being requested:
clinical_service_or_procedure: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes / CTPs - Initial 4 Applications for DFU or VLU

criteria.description: Wound is > 1 square centimeter
Failed ≥ 50% ulcer area reduction after ≥ 4 weeks of standard of care (SOC) wound treatment
Requested product is one of the preferred products (Apligraf, Dermagraft, Epifix, Grafix, Integra, Kerecis, Oasis, etc.)
Only one CTP in place per wound episode

required_documentation: Photographic documentation with visible ruler at baseline and follow-up
Complete description of product, size, and NDC
Wound treatment notes verifying 4 weeks failed SOC
review_notes: Initial authorization strictly limited to up to 4 applications.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.185: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes
source_quote: continued treatment beyond the initial four applications and up to a total of eight applications with skin and soft tissue substitutes/cellular and tissue-based products (CTPs) is medically necessary for diabetic foot ulcers (DFU) or venous leg ulcers (VLU) when all of the following criteria are met, specific to the wound for which the skin substitute/CTP is being requested:
clinical_service_or_procedure: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes / CTPs - Continued Treatment (Applications 5 to 8)

criteria.description: Initial 4 applications resulted in wound healing and expectation of continued healing
Total cumulative applications will not exceed 8 per wound per 12-week episode
Modifiable risk factors (diabetes, venous insufficiency) adequately addressed

required_documentation: Sequential photos with visible ruler demonstrating wound size reduction
Treatment notes explaining medical necessity of extended applications
review_notes: Strict cap of 8 total applications per 12-week episode.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.185: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes
source_quote: skin and soft tissue substitutes/CTPs for diabetic foot ulcers (DFU) and venous leg ulcers (VLU) are not medically necessary for the following indications or scenarios: A. Any usage not listed in section I. or II. of the policy; B. Greater than eight applications of a skin and soft tissue substitute/CTP within an episode of care
clinical_service_or_procedure: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes / CTPs - DFU/VLU Exclusions

criteria.description: Greater than 8 applications within 12-week episode of care
Repeat application when previous application was unsuccessful
Active infection, necrosis, active Charcot arthropathy, or ischemia
Liquid or gel CTP formulation for ulcer care

review_notes: Explicit frequency limit of 8 applications and clinical contraindications.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.185: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes
source_quote: burn treatment with skin and soft tissue substitutes/CTPs (including the procedure, product, service) is considered medically necessary when meeting all the following, specific to the wound for which the skin substitute/CTP is being requested: A. Request indicates the specific wound to which the skin and soft tissue substitute/CTP will be applied; B. Request is for four weeks of treatment at a time; C. The wound is > 1 square centimeter; D. Sufficient autograft is not available
clinical_service_or_procedure: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes / CTPs - Burn Treatment

criteria.description: Burn is deep partial-thickness or full-thickness
Sufficient autograft is not available or feasible
No evidence of burn wound infection
Treatment with approved allograft, xenograft, or tissue-engineered CTP (Biobrane, Epicel, etc.)

required_documentation: Burn center clinical notes documenting depth and TBSA
review_notes: Approved for 4 weeks of treatment at a time for deep partial or full thickness burns.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.185: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes
source_quote: treatment with skin and soft tissue substitutes/CTPs for breast reconstruction are considered medically necessary when meeting all of the following, specific to the wound for which the skin substitute/CTP is being requested: A. Request indicates the specific wound to which the skin and soft tissue substitute/CTP will be applied; B. Request is for up to four weeks of treatment at a time; C. The wound is > 1 square centimeter; D. Post-mastectomy breast reconstruction;
clinical_service_or_procedure: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes - Post-Mastectomy Breast Reconstruction

criteria.description: Post-mastectomy breast reconstruction
No evidence of wound infection
Approved product: AlloDerm, Cortiva, DermaCell, or FlexHD/AllopatchHD

required_documentation: Product label and package size documentation
review_notes: Specifically covers acellular dermal matrices for post-mastectomy reconstruction.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.185: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes
source_section: Policy/Criteria - Section VI Mitten Hand OrCel
source_quote: OrCel™ is medically necessary for up to four weeks of treatment for mitten hand deformities due to dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa when meeting all the following, specific to the wound for which the skin substitute/CTP is being requested:
clinical_service_or_procedure: OrCel™ for Mitten Hand Deformities in Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa

criteria.description: Mitten hand deformities due to dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa
Used according to FDA HDE specifications
No evidence of wound infection

required_documentation: Surgical notes for mitten hand release
review_notes: FDA Humanitarian Device Exemption (HDE) protocol compliance required.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.185: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes
source_quote: skin and soft tissue substitutes/CTPs for post-reconstruction surgery of abdominal wall wounds are considered medically necessary when meeting all the following, specific to the wound for which the skin substitute/CTP is being requested: A. Request indicates the specific wound to which the skin and soft tissue substitute/CTP will be applied; B. Request is for up to four weeks of treatment at a time; C. The wound is > 1 square centimeter; D. Repair of hernias or for surgical repair of complex abdominal wall wounds;
clinical_service_or_procedure: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes - Complex Abdominal Wall Reconstruction

criteria.description: Repair of hernias or complex abdominal wall wounds
Approved product: Alloderm, Phasix ST, or Strattice
No evidence of wound infection

required_documentation: Surgical operative report detailing complex hernia/wall defect
Product label and size used with minimal wastage
review_notes: Indicated for complex abdominal wall hernia repair with Alloderm, Phasix ST, Strattice.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.185: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes
source_quote: skin and soft tissue substitutes/CTPs for any indication listed in sections IV to VII above are considered not medically necessary for any of the following: A. Treatment longer than twelve weeks; B. Repeat applications when initial treatment was unsuccessful for a period of four weeks past the start of therapy
clinical_service_or_procedure: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes - General Limitations and Duration Exclusions

criteria.description: Treatment duration longer than 12 weeks
Repeat application after 4 weeks of unsuccessful therapy
Retreatment of healed wounds (>75% reduction and <0.5 sq cm)

review_notes: Hard cap of 12 weeks maximum and prohibition against re-treating healed wounds.

policy_title: Clinical Policy CP.MP.185: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes
source_quote: current evidence does not support the use of skin and soft tissue substitutes/cellular and tissue-based products (CTPs) in the outpatient setting for either of the following: A. Indications other than those listed as medically necessary above, including but not limited to, pressure ulcers;
clinical_service_or_procedure: Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes - Outpatient Unproven Indications (e.g. Pressure Ulcers)

criteria.description: Requested in outpatient setting for pressure ulcers or unlisted indication

review_notes: Unproven in outpatient setting for pressure ulcers or other non-listed indications.
